03 / AI APPLICATION ENGINEERING CASE STUDY

Movie
Insights.

A Next.js application that combines OMDb movie metadata with Gemini-powered audience-sentiment analysis.

Next.jsTypeScriptRoute HandlersOMDbGoogle GeminiFramer Motion
DESIGN PRINCIPLE

Separate facts
from generation.

Movie metadata comes from the OMDb API. Generative analysis works on review text and returns an editorial summary, classification, confidence, themes, and sentiment distribution. The repository explicitly handles the fact that OMDb does not supply audience reviews by generating them in-app for analysis.

DETERMINISTIC

Movie route

GET /api/movie validates IMDb ID input and fetches movie data; the app renders metadata, plot, rating, and cast-oriented views.

GENERATIVE

Analysis route

POST /api/analyze sends review text to Gemini and returns a structured sentiment shape for the UI.

RESILIENCE

Fallback behavior

If Gemini is unavailable, the movie route falls back to OMDb actor/director/writer data. Loading and error components are included.

TRADE-OFF

Interpret, don’t misrepresent

Generated reviews are application data for the experiment—not presented here as real audience reviews.

SOURCE OF TRUTH

See how AI is
bounded by product context.
